Class InputReader

java.lang.Object
boundary.InputReader
public class InputReader extends Object
Reads the manager's choices from the console, or from a file piped in with java -cp out Main < testing/stage1-victory-input.txt.

It only checks that the input is a number in range. Whether the choice is allowed by the game rules is decided by the entity and control classes.

  • Constructor Details

    • InputReader

      public InputReader()
      Reads from the keyboard, or from a file piped in. When the input is piped (there is no interactive console), each choice read is printed back.

    • InputReader

      public InputReader(Scanner scanner)
      Reads from the given Scanner, so tests can pass in text such as new Scanner("abc\n9\n2\n"). Choices are not printed back.
      Parameters:
      scanner - where to read from

    • InputReader

      public InputReader(Scanner scanner, boolean echo)
      Reads from the given Scanner, optionally printing back each line it reads.
      Parameters:

      echo - true to print each line read, for piped replay runs

  • Method Details

    • readChoice

      public int readChoice(String prompt, int min, int max)
      Asks for a whole number from min to max, and keeps asking until it gets one.
      Parameters:
      prompt - the question to show
      min - the smallest allowed number
      max - the largest allowed number
      Returns:
      a number from min to max
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the input runs out (e.g. a replay file is too short)
